author: noggin
body: Implemented: Picker Preview lays the raw file out with the Text renderer (picker.showPreview, textLayout.patch shared with the viewer): soft wrap, tab expansion, gutter, exact ripgrep-column span highlight (spans soft-wrapped rows), re-layout on resize. Messages (binary/unreadable/article) are wrapped without a gutter. Test pins Preview == Text-mode viewer content after activation at equal width. Notes: Preview scrolls the match to the top of the pane (not EnsureVisible, so more context shows below); per-selection-move l.find scans the file (not cached).
